summary: Validated SEDUC/CE restyling of the inscrição confirmation email template, static asset serving, end-to-end inscription flow, and the '?cpf=' hydration of pagamento-pix.html (clean browser context + stale localStorage override). All targeted assertions pass.

minor.issue: When neither RESEND_API_KEY/RESEND_FROM nor EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY are set, send_email() still falls through to the Emergent branch and sends 'X-Email-Key: None', which raises 'Header value must be str or bytes, not <class NoneType>' and is logged as ERROR by try_send_email. It is caught (no crash, inscrição flow completes), but it should short-circuit early (return False) when no provider is configured and log INFO instead of ERROR. Observed in backend.err.log right after inscricao_finalizada.

action_items: (Optional / minor) In backend/email_service.py send_email(), early-return/raise cleanly when both RESEND_* and EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY are unset, so logs don't show an ERROR stacktrace during inscrição finalization while no provider is configured.
